title: Return to Hiigara
blurb: Makaan besieges the homeworld and his planet killers are falling. Sajuuk is coming home, and the Dreadnought is in the line. She has never been closer to waking.
primer: The final chapter. Makaan has brought the whole Vaygr fleet to Hiigara, and he has planet killers.
The fleet went through the Balcora Gate to the galaxy's core and found Sajuuk, the great Progenitor flagship. The Pride of Hiigara was left behind there. Karan S'jet is bringing Sajuuk home.
The countdown decides how hard the Dreadnought fights you today. What happens to her is up to you.
gmNotes:
Act Three, mission six and the finale of the Dreadnought arc, around Homeworld 2's defence of Hiigara.
The Pride of Hiigara is abandoned in the galactic core; Sajuuk, with Karan S'jet joined to it, leads the fleet. Sajuuk destroys Makaan's flagship at the end, whatever the crew do.
The Sajuuk thread: at countdown 7+ or with sajuukHeard, Vash’Kora calls to a dormant Progenitor mind in Sajuuk. Silence the call (callCut, -1) or it stirs (sajuukStirring): Karan holds it, barely. It echoes in the battles and the endings.
The salvo battle depends on the countdown: under 4 she answers the helm; 4-5 she hesitates (locked stations); 6-7 she acts on her own; 8 she has the guns and turns on Hiigara.
The last salvo: fight through (kept), put her to sleep (knowsName: asleep), offer her a path (knowsName, under 6: ally), use her as a shield (any countdown: shield, the sure way at 8), or lose her.
Flags left behind: dreadnought (kept/asleep/ally/shield/lost), hiigaraHit, sajuukStirring, callCut.
Tone: everything at once. Let the crew feel the weight of every missile, and of what they decide to do with her.

briefing.speaker: Fleet Command
briefing.text: "All ships, Fleet Command. Hiigara is under siege. Makaan has brought everything he has. Word from the core: the fleet found what the Bentusi promised. The Pride of Hiigara is left behind there, empty. Karan S'jet has joined with something far greater, and she's bringing it home. Hold until she comes."

arrival.speaker: Narrator
arrival.text: You drop out of hyperspace into the worst of it: Hiigara's sky crowded with Vaygr. Then space folds open beside you, and Sajuuk comes home. It's vast and ancient, Progenitor-built, the flagship that is now the fleet's heart. On your bridge, every display turns towards it.

spear-line.speaker: Narrator
spear-line.text: The Spear of Soban takes her place off your bow in the line, scorched and patched and Hiigaran. Her captain signals the old Soban greeting, and adds: "Whatever happens today, we're with you."

the-call.speaker: The Dreadnought
the-call.text: She sings. There's no other word for it: a note through every deck, every bulkhead, every bone, thrown out across the dark at Sajuuk. "Sibling. Wake. They put a small thing in your heart. Wake and put it out."

karan-asks.speaker: Karan S'jet
karan-asks.text: A new voice on your channel, calm and strained, a voice the whole fleet knows: "Dreadnought, this is Karan S'jet. Something in here is listening to your ship. Something old, under me. I can hold it, but not for long. Whatever she's saying, make her stop."

cut-link.prompt: Cut the channel between two Progenitor minds before the one in Sajuuk wakes up and answers.

approaches.label: Tear out her transmitter by hand

pass.text: The note breaks off mid-song. On Sajuuk, whatever was stirring settles back into the dark. Karan breathes out over the channel: "Thank you."

fail.text: The note goes on and on. And then, from Sajuuk, something sings back.

stirring.speaker: Sajuuk
stirring.text: A voice below hearing, slower even than hers, from the flagship itself: "Who calls. Who wakes me. What is this small bright thing in my heart." Over the channel, Karan S'jet, through her teeth: "Me. It's me. Go back to sleep."

isolation-note.speaker: Narrator
isolation-note.text: Whatever else happens today, the system you cut her out of at Balcora stays dark to her. It's dark to you too, but it's yours.

line.speaker: Fleet Command
line.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. Makaan's battle line is coming in to cover his planet killers. Break that line, or the planet killers get a clear run at the homeworld."

unleash.prompt: The last offer, maybe. She's showing you a power you haven't seen before, enough to break the whole line at once.

options.label: Let her loose
options.hint: Break them. The countdown runs on.

options.label: Fight her as a Hiigaran ship
options.hint: Hold her back for what's coming

line-battle.intro: A Vaygr battlecruiser leads the line, her heavy guns charging, with a destroyer and frigates in support. Stations.

phases.text: The Spear of Soban rakes the battlecruiser's flank, close enough to scorch her own paint. "Now, Dreadnought!"

phases.speaker: Sajuuk
phases.text: "Small ships. Small fires. Why do you fight beside the singer." A shiver runs through Sajuuk's hull. Karan doesn't answer it, and that's worse.

victory.text: The battlecruiser breaks in two and the Vaygr line comes apart around her. Then, behind it, the planet killers move up.

defeat.text: The line batters the Dreadnought back, but Sajuuk's guns break it for you. Then, behind it, the planet killers move up.

launch.speaker: Narrator
launch.text: The planet killers come out of the Vaygr line: vast, slow, spidery ships, unfolding their legs as they take station above Hiigara. Then they fire. Every missile that lands will kill a city. And on the bridge, as if she's been waiting for exactly this, the Dreadnought begins to fight you for the helm.

salvo-0.intro: She answers the helm. It's all flying and gunnery now: every missile you stop is a city that lives. Stations.

impact.text: Planet killer one punches through the upper atmosphere. A light blooms over Hiigara, and the comms channels fill with screaming.
Planet killer two punches through the upper atmosphere. A light blooms over Hiigara, and the comms channels fill with screaming.

phases.text: The planet killer fires again. Two more missiles fall towards Hiigara.

impact.text: Planet killer three punches through the upper atmosphere. A light blooms over Hiigara, and the comms channels fill with screaming.
Planet killer four punches through the upper atmosphere. A light blooms over Hiigara, and the comms channels fill with screaming.

phases.speaker: Karan S'jet
phases.text: Sajuuk's great guns swing round, past the missiles, onto you. Then, slowly, away. Karan's voice is a whisper: "I have it. I have it. Get her out of my head."

victory.text: The salvo is spent. The planet killer is reloading. One more salvo, the biggest yet, and the Dreadnought is pulling at the helm.

defeat.text: The Dreadnought staggers out of the salvo's path, burning, and Hiigara takes the hits you couldn't stop. The planet killer is reloading for one last salvo.

"I will do the {station}." Your console locks, politely, completely.

wrestle.prompt: Get to the helm through a bridge that doesn't want you there, and take her back by force.
wrestle.reason: Wrestle the Dreadnought for the helm

approaches.label: Force your way to the helm

pass.text: The helm comes back under your hands with a jolt that throws half the bridge off their feet. She's still fighting. But she's yours, for now.

fail.text: The helm burns your hands. She doesn't even notice you're there any more.

sleep.prompt: "Vash’Kora." The bridge goes still. Now talk her down, gently, all the way down, while the last salvo falls.
sleep.label: Ask Vash’Kora to rest

approaches.label: Ease her systems down one by one
Show her the road she laid

pressure: The last salvo is past the moon. Sajuuk's guns are reaching for it.

complete.text: "Rest," she repeats, as if she's never heard the word. The note in the decks drops, and drops, and stops. Her displays stay lit, and they stay in Hiigaran. Sajuuk's guns take the last salvo apart in the upper air.

timeout.text: She won't sleep. Not now, not with the sky on fire. There's one way left.

sleep-hard.prompt: "Vash’Kora." She's so far gone it barely reaches her. Keep saying it while the last salvo falls.
sleep-hard.label: Ask Vash’Kora to rest

approaches.label: Ease her systems down one by one
Show her the road she laid

pressure: The last salvo is past the moon.

complete.text: On the last breath of it, she hears you. "Vash’Kora," she says, wonderingly, as if remembering. Then: "Rest." The lance powers down. Sajuuk's guns take the last salvo apart in the upper air.

timeout.text: She's too far gone to hear her own name. There's one way left.

path.prompt: "Vash’Kora. Architect of Paths. Stop the salvo with us, and we'll give you a road: a place in the fleet, and a home that isn't a grave."
path.reason: Offer the Architect of Paths a road

pass.text: A long silence. Then every gun on the ship swings onto the last salvo at once, with an accuracy no Hiigaran crew could match. "A road," she says. "Yes. Show me." The sky over Hiigara is empty.

fail.text: "Small things offering roads," she says, and laughs, if it is a laugh. She takes the helm.

shield-helm.prompt: You can't steer her well enough to shoot the salvo down. But you can put the whole ship in its path. Lock the helm onto the salvo's course before she notices what you're doing.
shield-helm.reason: Set the helm into the salvo

approaches.label: Lock the course and burn the controls

pass.text: The course locks. She feels it too late, and the whole ship howls. You have three minutes.

fail.text: It takes far too long, by hand, with her fighting you for every degree. The course locks with barely two minutes left.

evacuate.prompt: It's Tanis again: corridors, alarms, the lifeboats aft. Except this time the ship herself is trying to keep you aboard.
evacuate.label: Get everyone off before the salvo hits
pressure: A bulkhead closes ahead of you, gently. You force it.
"Stay," she says, in every corridor at once. "Stay with me."

complete.text: The last lifeboat clears her hull with seconds to spare. Behind you, the Dreadnought flies straight and true into the heart of the last salvo, and the sky over Hiigara turns white.

timeout.text: The last lifeboat tears free as the salvo hits, and the blast throws it end over end. Not everyone in it walks away unhurt. Behind you, the Dreadnought is gone, and so are the missiles.

lose-sajuuk.speaker: Karan S'jet
lose-sajuuk.text: Karan S'jet, very quietly: "I'm sorry. The thing under me wants to answer her, and I can't hold it while she sings. Get to your lifeboats. Now." Sajuuk's guns fire once. The Dreadnought breaks apart, and on Sajuuk, the voice beneath Karan goes silent.

lose-fleet.speaker: Fleet Command
lose-fleet.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. We can't let her fire on the homeworld. Abandon ship." You barely make the lifeboats. Behind you, Sajuuk and the fleet turn their guns on the ship that carried you this far.

lost.speaker: Narrator
lost.text: She goes in silence. The last salvo is taken apart by Sajuuk's guns, but not before two cities burn.

toll.speaker: Narrator
toll.text: Not every missile was stopped. Below the clouds, cities that were there this morning are burning, and the fleet's rescue ships are already falling towards them.

makaan.speaker: Narrator
makaan.text: Then Sajuuk turns on Makaan's flagship, and it is over very quickly. The Vaygr fleet breaks and runs. Across the galaxy, gate after gate begins to wake, and the age of hyperspace begins.

end-kept.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands. The Daiamid want to know what to do with her. They've decided to ask her crew." On the bridge, the hum is low and steady. She's still in there. So are you.

end-kept-uneasy.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands, and the Dreadnought is yours." A private channel, later, from Karan S'jet: "Keep her away from Sajuuk. The thing under me hasn't gone back to sleep. It's listening for her."

end-asleep.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands." Her mind sleeps, perhaps for good. What's left is the greatest warship the Hiigarans have ever flown, and she answers to her crew alone.

end-ally.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands, and we're told your ship has asked, politely, for a star chart of the whole galaxy." Vash’Kora, the Architect of Paths, is awake and part of the fleet. Nobody knows yet what that means.

end-ally-sajuuk.text: "Dreadnought, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands." Vash’Kora is awake and part of the fleet. And at night, across the anchorage, she and the thing beneath Karan S'jet talk softly to each other in a language no one else can follow.

end-shield.text: "All ships, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands, because a crew put their own ship in front of the last salvo. That's twice now they've lost a ship and kept their heads. The fleet will find them a third."

end-lost.text: "Dreadnought crew, Fleet Command. Hiigara stands. You did everything that could be done." Below, two cities are still burning. Nobody will say it was your fault. Some nights, you will.
